preregistered_change.description: Extend only the unchanged v0.79 adaptive selector boundary from at most 10 compiled queries to at most 12 compiled queries.

failed_dataset.name: _deprecated_solar_flare_1
failed_dataset.compiler_shape: 12 low-cardinality exact queries and zero threshold queries
failed_dataset.interpretation: The query-count boundary was not the causal bottleneck. Activating the adaptive path at 12 queries still produced no state satisfying the frozen structural admissibility constraints.

decision.reason: A second opened-data threshold adjustment would be post-hoc tuning against the same exposed dataset and would not constitute stronger scientific evidence.
decision.next_scientifically_valid_step: Design a new generic state-generation principle from task-independent structural analysis, preregister it before touching another untouched dataset campaign, and evaluate it on a separately locked source. Do not relax the v0.82 or v0.83 acceptance thresholds retroactively.

claim_boundary: This is opened-data development evidence only. It is not an external validation, world-class result, general-AI breakthrough, peer-reviewed result, or outside-human reproduction.
